title: zanthoxylum retusum
intro: Zanthoxylum retusum, commonly known as Korean prickly ash, is a type of flowering plant in the Rutaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as protect against cell damage and infections. The therapeutic actions of Zanthoxylum retusum include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which can help to alleviate pain and discomfort in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use in traditional medicine.
